page_title: TLDRLegal - Software Licenses Explained in Plain English

summary.title: TLDRLegal - Software Licenses Explained in Plain English
summary.one_liner: A lookup site that summarizes popular open source software licenses (such as Apache-2.0, GPL-3 and MPL-2.0) in plain English.
takeaways: Look up a named open source license and get an at-a-glance plain-English summary.
Licenses featured on the page include BSL-1.0, MPL-2.0, Apache-2.0, MPL-1.1, GPL-2.0 and GPL-3.
Entries are marked as 'Verified Content' on the site.
The page itself gives no detailed license terms; open a specific license entry for the content.
summary.summary: This is the landing page of TLDRLegal, a site that lists popular software licenses with at-a-glance plain-English summaries. The page shows a list of featured licenses, including Boost 1.0, MPL 2.0, Apache 2.0, MPL 1.1, GPL 2.0 and GPL 3, and labels them as verified content. The visible text is mostly navigation, a contact form and FOSSA promotional material, so it contains few license details itself. It is best used as a reference index that links to per-license pages.
